integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, iPhone handheld realistic footage with fine sensor grain, real skin texture and visible pores, no plastic or waxy CGI look and no beauty-smoothing. Two East Asian women sit on a sofa exactly as in <Picture 1>, preserving their faces, clothing, the two glasses of red wine on the coffee table and the room layout. On the left, the 28-year-old woman with a translucent skincare gel on her face and a knitted home cardigan (S1) keeps a dark-screen unbranded phone face-down on her knee; on the right, the 29-year-old woman with clean bare skin and a loose cotton shirt (S2) has just set down her wine glass. The camera holds a mostly static handheld two-shot with slight natural sway.
